name: rebuild-identity
description: Proves the journal-is-source-of-truth / TEP-observations-are-its-projection rule (design §6.2, TEP §10.1): projecting this journal twice (a fresh boot vs. a rebuild after restart) must re-emit BYTE-IDENTICAL (source, id) observation pairs — the id is deterministically derived from the journal event, never randomly minted at emission time.

expected.note: the deterministic id-derivation rule this fixture pins is `${source}/${attemptId}/${seq}` — a rebuild that projects this journal a second time (e.g. after a crash-then-recover) must compute the SAME three ids, never new random ones; a real supervisor's derivation function is A5's decision, but whatever it is, it MUST be a pure function of (source, attemptId, seq)
